Good one, I like the story (maybe a bit long as on fastest mode, everything needs to go fast :O)
Why not activate 'Shortest mode' as well, I guess it could be a good candidate to play with XOR operator! :)

Gratz! Very original!
At the very end of the input description, please add a missing closing parenthesis. Thank you.

Goal
* Please format "0" and "1" as {{constants}}.

* The first paragraph is currently too long. Please split it into multiple paragraphs for better readability.

Input
* The input description doesn't match the actual input format. Please refer to the example here: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement and rewrite this section in a similar way.

Output / Cases / Solution
* Please revise the output format. The current format is too language-specific. Consider requiring the values to be space-separated rather than using a Python list representation.

* Please clarify that the expected output consists of {{0}} and {{1}}, not the words "white" and "black".

Constraints
* Please change 1,000,000 to 100 as [[N]] never exceeds 100 in the cases.

Cases
* Please remove the trailing newlines from the input for:
  • N=20 (Test 2)
  • Validator 4

* The current test cases don't fully cover all possible scenarios. Please ensure that there's at least one test and one validator for each situation:

  • The final prisoner's hat is black and they guess black.

  • The final prisoner's hat is black and they guess white.

  • The final prisoner's hat is white and they guess black.

  • The final prisoner's hat is white and they guess white.

Thanks.

Outstanding points:

Output
* Please clarify that the expected output consists of {{0}} and {{1}}, not the words "white" and "black".

Cases
* Cover all four possible scenarios in tests, and similarly in validators.

Thanks.
Thanks for your feedback. I believe I have addressed each comment. Please let me know if you see anything else that needs improvement.

Two outstanding points:

Output
* Please clarify that the expected output consists of {{0}} and {{1}}, not the words "white" and "black".

Cases
* Both Validators 1 and 2 cover the scenario that the final prisoner wears a black hat and guesses black. Please modify one of them to cover the case that the hat is still black but the guess is white instead.

Thanks.

(Black / Guesses White): Covered by N=20 Test and Validator 3.
(White / Guesses Black): Covered by N=50 Test and Validator 2.
(White / Guesses White): Covered by N=100 Test and Validator 4.

I re-submitted all the answers to make it easier to keep track of:
N = 3: Final prisoner's hat is Black (1) and they guess Black (1)
N = 20: Final prisoner's hat is Black (1) and they guess White (0).

N = 100: Final prisoner's hat is White (0) and they guess White (0).
